description:
Run (enqueue) a file check for a file in a file session: the proof service preflights the file against the product's print specs and produces a report of errors/warnings. Unlike create_proof it makes NO proof file — the report is the whole result, and there is nothing to approve.

Use it when the session is NOT proofable but isFileCheckAvailable is true (read get_file_session_proofs first). When the session is proofable, prefer create_proof.

Returns { checkId, ... } once enqueued. A check takes tens of seconds — after calling this, poll get_file_session_proofs until the `checks` entry whose `id` equals checkId reaches status COMPLETED, then report its errors/warnings. Refuses (tool error, nothing queued) when the session or file isn't eligible for a file check — do not retry a refusal.

ONLY call this on the customer's explicit go-ahead (a run-file-check quick-action click or a clear yes) — never unprompted. The file must already be uploaded to the session.

fileName.description: The file in the session to check (exact name).

fileSessionId.description: File session ID holding the uploaded file.

name: create_file_check
